# Datoviz v0.4

Datoviz v0.4 is a C-first GPU scientific visualization engine. The active public path is scene and
app APIs lowering through DRP2 to the runtime; do not assume v0.3 API compatibility.

## Start

- Overview: https://datoviz.org/start/what-is-datoviz/
- Choose a layer: https://datoviz.org/start/choose-your-layer/
- First C program: https://datoviz.org/start/first-c-program/
- Build from source: https://datoviz.org/start/build-from-source/
- Project status: https://datoviz.org/start/project-status/
